releaseNote: Marks are held until you release them from the Submissions tab (Release Result).
omrOff: OMR sheet mode is off for this assessment. Turn it on in Basic Info to print sets and scan sheets.

settings.title: Sets & shuffle
settings.subtitle: How many paper sets to print and whether they differ.
settings.setAHint: Set A always keeps the order the questions were authored in; shuffling applies to the other sets.
settings.locked: Filled sheets have been uploaded, so the sets are locked: changing them now would no longer match the printed papers and sheets.

roll.title: Roll-number pre-check
roll.subtitle: Each learner bubbles their enrollment number as the roll number.
roll.ok: Every participant has a usable enrollment number. The OMR sheets can be downloaded.
roll.fixHint: Fix the enrollment numbers in Manage Students, then re-check. OMR sheets cannot be downloaded until every number is usable.

sets.title: Paper sets
sets.confirmBody: Regenerating replaces all sets; reprint every paper and sheet.
sets.paperIssues: This paper cannot be printed as an OMR sheet yet:
sets.lockedHint: Sheets have been uploaded, so the sets can no longer be regenerated.
sets.sheetBlocked: OMR sheets can be downloaded once the roll-number pre-check passes.
sets.empty: No sets yet. Generate them to download the papers and OMR sheets.

upload.drop: Drop sheets here or click to choose
upload.dropHint: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to {{max}} files · {{mb}} MB each
upload.notAccepted: {{name}} is not a PDF, JPG or PNG file
upload.tooMany: At most {{max}} files per upload; split it
upload.nothingUploaded: None of the files could be uploaded
upload.someFailed_one: {{count}} file could not be uploaded and was left out.
upload.someFailed_other: {{count}} files could not be uploaded and were left out.

uploads.title: Uploaded sheets
uploads.subtitle: Every upload of filled sheets for this assessment, newest first.

assign.search: Search by name or enrollment number
